subject: Build: make the Make / CMake gtest build link on macOS (#4657)
reason: The change only modifies the gtest unit-test build machinery (src/unit CMakeLists.txt and Makefile, plus the symbol-wrapping Python scripts) so the unit-test binary links on macOS. It compiles no code into valkey-server or any shipped tool and changes no runtime behaviour, replies, persistence, or replication, so there is no server-visible path for a scenario to exercise.
